question: controlled development residual diagnosis
REAL_REAL_definition: TRAIN fit2000 vs DEV2000; same acquisition disjoint role groups; not R4 half EVAL

recommended_next_test.priority_recipe: same R3B conditional mean backbone + unsmoothed local joint / first-and-second-difference distribution constraints + low-dimensional signal-envelope gated short-correlated zero-mean process
recommended_next_test.rationale: prompt conditional curvature is excessive except q1, whereas postpeak curvature lacks charge-dependent spread and local-baseline residual is separate; do not indiscriminately increase global white noise or smooth every pulse
recommended_next_test.process_equation_proposal: delta_v(t)=A(c)*e(t;c,z)*eta_rho(t); eta_rho is normalized zero-mean short filtered independent noise; e is zero on pretrigger baseline and has an explicit smooth postpeak envelope; A uses allowed G4 condition, not a sampled REAL template
recommended_next_test.coupled_constraints: complete QC TRAIN distributions of local voltage/shape patches and derivatives, balanced prompt/postpeak/tail blocks, conditional charge occupancy/CDF retained; no particle-truth or FoM-maximization loss
recommended_next_test.mechanism_ablation: two arms both receive the identical new local joint constraint, same R3B checkpoint/trainable initialization, allowed TRAIN statistics, seed/update/selection budget; signal-envelope process on versus identically disabled; share parent/z/baseline white and save additional independent process RNG
specific_risks: Adding noise to q3/q4 prompt can worsen existing excess curvature; separate the postpeak envelope from the prompt shape constraint.
The new gated process does not itself repair pretrigger RMS spread/ACF; baseline-local C2ST remains a separate outcome.
Positive/negative control sensitivity and all retained distribution metrics must accompany candidate comparisons.
Only a bounded new task can implement this proposal; no R8 fit in R7.

publication_payload: summary statistics/config only; no event IDs, selections or individual heldout predictions; full local result/predictions preserved
